content: {"like": ["Good selection of old jazz/swing films featuring greats such as Duke Ellington, Count Basie, Nat King Cole, the Dorsey brothers, Louis Jordan, Cab Calloway, Lena Horne, the Andrews Sisters, Artie Shaw, Lionel Hampton, and Sara Vaughn.", "Value for money – bought for 9 bucks and considered worth it.", "Opportunity to see rare footage that doesn’t get a lot of play otherwise.", "Accompanying booklet provides decent information on each film."], "dislike": ["Video quality on some films is mediocre at best.", "Lack of convenient labeling – two to three movies crammed onto each side of each disc.", "Some films (e.g., \"The Great Gabbo\", \"Sing, Cowboy, Sing\", \"Minstrel Man\") are goofy and of their era, which may be less entertaining."]}
